design.records: Exactly two caller-owned stable records embedded in persistent construction block; host allocation/admission before native events; runtime explicitly retains failure-survivor blocks
design.registration: Noalloc/no callback after successful B1F850 before camera publication; two explicit attempt-specific admissions; no ambient next-admission field
design.lookup: One intrusive actual-address registry; pure lookup only; no copy, retain, dimensions or fallback
design.routing: One module-scoped host borrowed registry binding prepared before construction. Multiple construction runtimes share it. B1F8F0 common source entry retires actual identity for flags0 and flags1; no native owner metadata/native global
design.retirement: Unlink live key before native destructor/free; keep inert never-rebound host records until explicit host quiescence, then forget and reclaim construction storage. No shadow count or delayed native free
design.constructor_failure: B1F850 failure was never registered; raw free unchanged. B71A80 late failure preserves first registry/native owner. B3C800 late failure preserves camera and companions. Cancel only unused credits
design.queue: Camera/reference/environment/registry/construction block survive helper free while actual queued camera count remains. Queue camera reference does not retain an earlier viewport snapshot
design.unsupported: Competing registry installation, bypass direct free, arbitrary native profiles, concurrent publication without actual scheduling contract; no blanket ban on field mutation/helper-camera replacement/nested preparation

all_callers.limit: Other setup sites enumerated but not audited; no universal all-callers contract. B1F8F0 and B26770 indirect graph absence is not no-use proof.

remaining_blockers: Current semantic raw-pointer viewport() API exposes host view indefinitely; explicit host borrow end/cache detachment must precede construction-block reclamation.
